title: Mega Man 2: The Power Fighters
note: Capcom CPS2 fighting game: health, health_p2 (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x20 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x20 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

_time.note: part of the timer only (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Time writes 45), read to see that the game runs, not shown

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

hd.note: HD themes of the fights (one per game, no stage value known), made by tools/cps_games.py
